validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. Bundle benchmark 04/11/26 (whole persona core vs no skill, one frontier model, isolated no-tool sessions, deterministic scorers): all 9 closed decision cases at ceiling in both arms; three open design tasks, two trials each: webhook service 5/7, 5/7 -> 6/7, 6/7; AI support assistant 7/9, 5/9 -> 9/9, 8/9; right-sizing an analytics stack 5/6, 5/6 -> 6/6, 6/6 (rubric-only tie; difference is the document standard). Skilled answers were 2-3x longer and slower. Scorer and checker corrections recorded. Results apply to the bundle as a whole; controller-authored cases, not independent review.
sources: Principles distilled from: Google, Site Reliability Engineering (Embracing Risk; Service Level Objectives) and The Site Reliability Workbook (Implementing SLOs; Non-Abstract Large System Design), free online editions; Alex Xu, System Design Interview vol. 1, author-hosted framework chapter; system-design-primer (CC BY 4.0). Paraphrased; no source text reproduced.
